install_bash_completion: install hydra bash completion by printing a shell script that sets up tab completion for hydra apps
uninstall_bash_completion: uninstall hydra bash completion by printing commands to unset the completion function and restore the old rule
query_completion_suggestions: query hydra completion suggestions for a given config name using COMP_LINE from the environment
get_help_for_install_or_uninstall: get the eval command string for installing or uninstalling hydra bash completion in the shell
get_executable_name: get the executable name from sys.argv to determine if running as a python script or installed app
